shared_elements: large circular disc or ring on the torso
arched horizontal band made of multiple parallel curved lines

justification: The strongest correspondence is the distinctive torso scheme: a circular disc above or within the chest/abdomen area, set over a multi-line arched band with short vertical marks below and a small circle lower down, all rendered schematically in shallow linear relief. The main difference is that A shows the larger anthropomorphic figure with head, shoulders, and additional upper-body features, while B is cropped to the torso motif only.
